entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Yuanling
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Yuanling is a Latin Church ecclesiastical jurisdiction or diocese of the Catholic Church in the county of Yuanling (Hunan), China. It is a suffragan in the ecclesiastical province of the metropolitan Archdiocese of Changsha, yet depends on the missionary Roman Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples.
